preflight.emptyBody: Open Video → Configuration/Adaptation, prepare a PRE, and HocusPocus will open it here without covering the comic canvas.
preflight.title: Comic film PRE · {{count}} planned shots
preflight.hint: This is a separate review workspace. Changes are saved into the durable PRE checkpoint before generation.
preflight.staleBanner: This recovered PRE belongs to an older comic/configuration state. It remains viewable, but editing, approval and generation are locked. Return to Video and prepare a new PRE.
preflight.unsaved: Unsaved PRE edits. Saving rebuilds prepared inputs and invalidates approval and earlier tests.
preflight.legacy: Legacy PRE without a backend fingerprint. Rebuild it from Video; this checkpoint cannot be safely approved or generated.
preflight.gatePending: ; run and review the representative test before full generation.
preflight.reviewFirst: Review every required test video in its shot card first
preflight.waiverPlaceholder: Why is a representative test unsafe, unavailable or intentionally skipped?
preflight.unresolved_one: {{count}} enabled shot requested AI reframe but has no real prepared keyframe. Reframe import/generation is not available yet; choose Contain/Cover and save.
preflight.unresolved_other: {{count}} enabled shots requested AI reframe but has no real prepared keyframe. Reframe import/generation is not available yet; choose Contain/Cover and save.
preflight.sourceMissing: Source unavailable in this recovered PRE
preflight.testReview: Generated representative test · human review required
preflight.acceptClip: I reviewed this exact generated clip and accept its visual quality.
preflight.noTestVideo: The quality result has no playable video filename. Reload after the test finishes; this shot cannot be visually accepted yet.
preflight.reframeBlocked: AI reframe was requested, but this PRE has no real prepared keyframe. The backend used a safe contain fallback and blocks generation. Reframe import/generation is not available yet; change Fit to Contain/Cover and save.
preflight.aspectNote: Source and output aspect ratios differ substantially. {{fit}} is an explicit editorial choice; inspect the prepared input before approval.
preflight.cinemagraph: AI living still · subtle full-frame I2V
preflight.legacyReframe: Legacy reframe request · change to Contain/Cover
preflight.spokenI2v: Automatic video-model prompts include a bounded excerpt as a performance and native-audio cue. Native model audio is not deterministic TTS: exact wording, timing and voice identity are not guaranteed. A manual prompt must include any words that must be attempted.
preflight.spokenHold: This deterministic motion method preserves the line for later dubbing or subtitles; it does not synthesize speech.
preflight.generateClip: Generate only this approved test clip
preflight.recoveredEdits: Recovered unsaved PRE edits from this browser for the exact same fingerprint.
preflight.discardEdits: Discard unsaved PRE edits and open the requested prepared shot list?
preflight.viewOnlyEdit: This recovered PRE is view-only. Rebuild it from the current comic before editing.
preflight.viewOnlyReorder: This recovered PRE is view-only. Rebuild it from the current comic before reordering.
preflight.staleRebuild: The comic or film configuration changed after this PRE was built. Return to Video and rebuild it.
preflight.noFingerprint: This legacy PRE has no backend fingerprint. Rebuild it from Video before editing or generating.
preflight.unresolvedApprove_one: {{count}} enabled shot requested AI reframe but has no real prepared keyframe. Reframe import/generation is not available yet; change each to Contain/Cover and save.
preflight.unresolvedApprove_other: {{count}} enabled shots requested AI reframe but has no real prepared keyframe. Reframe import/generation is not available yet; change each to Contain/Cover and save.
preflight.needWaiver: Explain why the representative quality test is being waived. The reason is stored with the PRE.
preflight.approveBeforeWaiver: Approve this exact PRE first; only an approved fingerprint can receive a quality-test waiver.
preflight.waiverConfirm: Waive the representative quality test for this exact PRE fingerprint? This is an auditable exception, not a successful quality test.
preflight.savedInvalidated: PRE changes saved and prepared inputs rebuilt. Approval and earlier quality tests were invalidated.
preflight.waiverAccepted: Quality test waived with an auditable reason. Full generation is unlocked for this approved PRE.
preflight.approvedUnlocked: PRE approved; quality gate {{status}}. Full generation is unlocked for this exact fingerprint.
preflight.approvedRunTest: PRE approved. Run the selected representative clips and pass the quality gate before full generation.
preflight.savedNotApprovedReframe: PRE was saved but not approved: at least one requested AI reframe still lacks a real prepared keyframe.
preflight.savedNotApproved: PRE was saved but the backend did not approve this fingerprint. Reload it before generating.
preflight.waiverRejected: The backend did not accept the quality waiver for this PRE fingerprint.
preflight.acceptOnlyApproved: Only the current saved and approved PRE can accept a representative quality test.
preflight.testNotReady: The complete required test set is not ready for review yet. Reload after the test jobs finish.
preflight.reviewShots: Review and confirm the test video for shot {{list}} first.
preflight.reviewShots_other: Review and confirm the test video for shots {{list}} first.
preflight.acceptConfirm_one: Accept the {{count}} completed representative clip for this exact PRE fingerprint?
preflight.acceptConfirm_other: Accept the {{count}} completed representative clips for this exact PRE fingerprint?
preflight.gateFailed: The backend did not pass the quality gate for this fingerprint.
preflight.accepted: Representative clips accepted. Full generation is now unlocked for this exact approved PRE.
preflight.viewOnlyTest: This recovered PRE is view-only. Rebuild it before changing the test selection.
preflight.testsPicked: Selected {{count}} representative PRE shots by aspect risk, motion method and motion level.
preflight.viewOnlyDuration: This recovered PRE is view-only. Rebuild it before changing shot durations.
preflight.durationApplied: Applied {{duration}}s to every enabled final PRE shot. Save to freeze the new timing.
preflight.needTestShot: Select at least one enabled PRE shot for the quality test.
preflight.noEnabled: No enabled PRE shots are available.
preflight.needFingerprint: This PRE has no backend fingerprint. Rebuild it before generation.
preflight.staleGenerate: This PRE is stale relative to the current comic or film settings. Rebuild it from Video.
preflight.approveBeforeTest: Approve this exact saved PRE before running representative test clips.
preflight.fullLocked: Full generation requires this exact PRE fingerprint to be approved and its representative quality gate to be passed or explicitly waived.
preflight.reconnected: Reconnected to the already-running PRE generation.
